_comments: Dependency order: our company, then customers, then the contracts that
reference both. Contracts last also means the change order's parent exists
by the time it is pushed — within one folder, file order is the array order. Modifications last: they reference both a contract and a provision.

The predictive-scoring bench (issue #89) follows: the pipeline, the model versions that name it, the record process that names a model in its Configuration, then the binding that names both. None of it references the demo contracts, only the Contracts entity.
contract-template-publish publishes the template once its provisions exist: a Published template takes no new provisions, and a Draft one takes no new contracts.
